notes.title: Play Jett Rider on Steam Deck!
notes.notes:
Hi Space explorers!

We have very good news because Jett Rider is perfectly playable on Steam Deck! Now, you can enjoy this fantastic action adventure on this amazing portable pc!

Don't miss the opportunity to join Jett in his epic adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44387212/be58f42e5d7e643f4c589810f5302357131557eb.jpg[/img]

[h3]And remember! Your opinion is very important to indie developers! 🙏 Please write a review about Jett Rider🧑‍🚀 [/h3]

See you on Gravos!

notes.title: Jett Rider is on DreamHack Indie Showcase!
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce that Jett Rider will be featured in the DreamHack Indie Showcase!

Welcome to a new action-platformer game. Join Jett on his epic galactic adventure by playing the public demo on Steam. Share your best moments on social media, and be sure to add the game to your Steam Wishlist!
